svg.title: Bounding Gaussian tails
svg.desc: Illustrative standard-normal density with a cutoff at minus and plus two standard deviations. The bounded center contains 95.45 percent of the probability mass. The two unbounded tails together contain 4.55 percent. The tails must be accounted for with a bound, not discarded. This deliberately modest cutoff makes the tails visible; it is not a paper experiment.

g.text: An infinite domain, a bounded calculation
Illustration: standard normal noise, cutoff at ±2σ
Tail mass is bounded, not silently discarded.
